title: Lupin The 3rd Voice Actor Yukiko Nikaido Dies at 87
content: In the anime world, one of the biggest franchises that has been around for decades is Lupin The 3rd , the Gentleman Thief-focused series that routinely returns for new animated series and films.
author: ComicBook

title: Seven Seas to Release Ultraman by Kazuo Umezz: The Classic Manga Collection
content: Seven Seas announced on Friday that it has licensed Kazuo Umezz's (or Kazuo Umezu ) Ultraman manga. The company will release the series in large-trim hardcover as Ultraman by Kazuo Umezz: The Classic Manga Collection in July 2027.
author: ANN

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game's Trailer Previews DLC Character Rick Strowd
content: SNK began streaming a trailer on Friday for the Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game , and it previews Rick Strowd: Season 3 will launch on July 23 with six characters joining the roster in the next six months.
author: ANN

title: CUTIE STREET Members Guest Star as Pikachu Idol Group in Pokémon Horizons Anime
content: The staff of the Pokémon: Horizons anime announced on Friday that CUTIE STREET , who perform the current ending theme song "Cute na Kyūtai," will guest star as members of the Cutie Pika Pika idol group in the 147th episode. Cutie Pika Pika first appeared in the CD jacket visual for the ending theme song.
author: ANN

title: Teaser Videos for Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series A Bona Fide Killer Unveiled
content: Korean broadcasting studio MBC released two teaser trailers on July 9 and July 16 for its upcoming live-action series A Bona Fide Killer , offering a closer look at the double life of its assassin protagonist ahead of the series' July 31 debut.
author: ANN

title: Netflix Reveals Its Biggest Anime for 2026 So Far
content: The anime industry is booming these days, and even though Netflix isn’t entirely focused on the medium, the platform remains one of the biggest streaming services for fans looking for their anime fix.
author: ComicBook

title: Final Fantasy Resonance Game Posts New Trailer
content: Square Enix began streaming a new trailer on Friday for Final Fantasy Resonance , a new HD-2D offline game based on the first story arc of the defunct Final Fantasy Brave Exvius smartphone game.
author: ANN

title: Let's Play Webcomic's Season 4 Sets July 22 Return on Tapas
content: Rocketship Entertainment announced on Thursday that Leeanne M. Krecic 's (aka Mongie) Let's Play webcomic will officially return with Season 4 on Tapas on July 22. While Mongie previously confirmed last September the webcomic would resume after the conclusion of the anime adaptation, no launch date had been announced…
author: ANN

title: Voice Actress Yukiko Nikaido Dies at 87
content: The son of actress and voice actress Yukiko Nikaido announced on Facebook on Friday that Nikaido died on July 3 of old age. She was 87. Nikaido's son Sōsuke Yagyū announced the news on the Facebook page of Yatsugatake Club, a Yamanashi-based horticulture facility, restaurant, and gallery.
author: ANN

title: Tomb Raider King: End Line Sequel Launches in English Across 4 Major Webtoon Platforms
content: Tomb Raider King : End Line has officially launched in English on WEBTOON , Tapas , Tappytoon , and Manta as of July 14, bringing the sequel to the franchise to readers across multiple digital platforms simultaneously.
author: ANN
